blocks.text: Scripted geometry primitive: script exports geometry() and optional collider(); collider() may return a heightfield: an object's ground from a grid of heights (spawn api ColliderHeightfield)

ScriptedPrimitiveSpec = { kind: "scripted" script: ScriptRef params?: Record<string, unknown> // The script's ctx.params. A param whose value is `{ samples: "/cdn/value.<sha>.png" }` (an uploaded PNG) arrives as its pixels (`spawn api GeometryContext`); a bare address stays a string. seed?: number // Deterministic seed for ctx.random/noise (default 0). Scatter templates that omit it get a per-instance seed, so scattered instances vary; set it explicitly when every instance should be identical. forward?: ForwardAxis // The axis the script's geometry was modelled to face (default "-z"); the engine turns every emitted vertex, normal, collider point and socket to −Z once, at the derive. A child's `feetPosition` does not turn: it stays in the object's frame, whose front is −Z. sockets?: PrimitiveSockets // Named points in the modelled frame (metres from the feet): a child's `attachment: { socket }` anchor and `getObjectSocket`'s answer. }

ScriptedPrimitiveSpec = {
  kind: "scripted"
  script: ScriptRef
  params?: Record<string, unknown>   // The script's ctx.params. A param whose value is `{ samples: "/cdn/value.<sha>.png" }` (an uploaded PNG) arrives as its pixels (`spawn api GeometryContext`); a bare address stays a string.
  seed?: number   // Deterministic seed for ctx.random/noise (default 0). Scatter templates that omit it get a per-instance seed, so scattered instances vary; set it explicitly when every instance should be identical.
  forward?: ForwardAxis   // The axis the script's geometry was modelled to face (default "-z"); the engine turns every emitted vertex, normal, collider point and socket to −Z once, at the derive. A child's `feetPosition` does not turn: it stays in the object's frame, whose front is −Z.
  sockets?: PrimitiveSockets   // Named points in the modelled frame (metres from the feet): a child's `attachment: { socket }` anchor and `getObjectSocket`'s answer.
}
